name: Henry III
source:
Itou family cat,  he is a white cat with a red collar. He was named after Wakaba's grandfather.
     In Haruna, Calls him "Shiro" (しろ), and Naoki calls him "Marshal Padlio" (パドリオ元帥).
     The boss cat in Yunohana town.
